videos.title: DECKER: Episode 1
videos.overview: Special agent Jack Decker takes on terror threats in Afghanistan to keep the world we know safe and secure. When the President himself is too scared to take on Al Qaeda, Decker steps in to extract valuable information from his source- information that could shake the very foundations of our free world.

videos.title: DECKER: Episode 2
videos.overview: After making his way into the the Oval Office, Decker tells the president the hard facts about the terrorist nuclear threat. Does President Davidson have enough integrity to give Jack Decker the resources he needs to fight terror, or will our hero have to take things into his own hands?

videos.title: DECKER: Episode 3
videos.overview: With an explosive suitcase in-hand, Decker struggles to get answers from the President's tight-lipped code expert. Will he break the three-digit code and reveal the sensitive information contained within the case? Or will the explosion destroy the United States capital and two centuries' worth of American history?

videos.title: DECKER: Episode 4
videos.overview: The suitcase has been opened, the nuclear threat analyzed, and, to Decker, the course of action is clear. Will the weak-willed president Davidson allow Decker to do what's necessary to protect America's citizens? What sacrifices will have to be made to save our nation?

videos.title: DECKER: Episode 5
videos.overview: Decker returns to the White House to inform President Davidson of the "Manhattan Incident."

videos.title: Announcement for All Movie Buffs Regarding The Missing Popcorn Classic
videos.overview:
As you know On Cinema is now Owned and Operated by V/H/S which is VFA at the Movie House incoprotaing Hie Network as a lesser company. Thus we have been able to set decisions regarding the rules of On Cinema as a broadcast enity. One basic rule is that each episode must have AT LEAST one Popcorn Classic (in some cases, as many as FOUR Popcorn Classics will be aired).

Because of the Editors that we have that have worked with Tim for a long time, mistakes have been made. In the latest episode a Popcorn Classic was inavertanly left out of the Edited episode even though it was supposed to be there. I was not made aware that it was missing until it was too late.

We are now pleased to bring you this Lost scene, the “missing” Popcorn Classic, now available for all Movie buffs!!!!

Pop up some popcorn and enjoy this Lost “Popcorn Classic”!!!!! This is a special treat for all Movie buffs!!!!

videos.title: 'The Man with the Iron Fists' and 'Flight'
videos.overview: This week, Tim and Gregg review instant classics 'The Man With the Iron Fists' and 'Flight' and actual classic Multiplicity.'

videos.title: 'Twilight: Part Two' and 'Anna Karenina'
videos.overview: It's chick flick week as Tim and Gregg review vampire movie 'Twilight: Breaking Dawn, Part 2' and Russian movie 'Anna Karenina,' plus Gregg debuts an educational new segment.

videos.title: 'The Frozen Ground' and 'Universal Soldier: Day of Reckoning'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg are both excited to discuss 'The Frozen Ground' and 'Universal Soldier: Day of Reckoning', but Tim sort of has a lot on his plate right now.

videos.title: 'Red Dawn' and 'Life of Pi'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg review 'Red Dawn' and 'Life of Pi,' which is maybe the weirdest movie ever made. And 'Twilight' fans are in for a treat, because Gregg has brought in his copy of the original 'Twilight' series!

videos.title: 'Skyfall' and 'Lincoln'
videos.overview: This week on On Cinema, Tim Heidecker and special guest Gregg Turkington give out some popcorns to 'Skyfall' and 'Lincoln', and Gregg has finally found another working copy of Murphy's Romance.

videos.title: 'Playing for Keeps' and 'Hyde Park on Hudson'
videos.overview: Playing For Keeps scores a gooooooaaal with Tim and Gregg, while Bill Murray should be elected President of Comedy, but not for playing FDR. Also Gregg takes us out to another famous Tinseltown location.

videos.title: 'The Hobbit' and 'Les Misérables'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg finally get to let their Hobbit Freak Flags fly as they chat about the adventures of Bilbo and the gang. Also, Les Miserables is a movie with music in it.

videos.title: 'Zero Dark Thirty' and 'Monsters, Inc. 3D'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg are both impressed by 'Zero Dark Thirty,' but can't exactly agree on whether to make a trip to the cinema for 3D films. Parking is expensive.

videos.title: 'Jack Reacher' and 'Cirque Du Soleil: Worlds Away'
videos.overview: Tim is happy to see Tom Cruise back in the spotlight, but a classic VHS debate sparks the Wrath of Gregg.

videos.title: 'Parental Guidance' and 'Django Unchained'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg discuss a family-friendly film, a not-so-family-friendly film, and disagree to disagree on their picks for the best film of 2012.

videos.title: 'Side Effects' and 'Identity Thief'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg kick off the second season of On Cinema at the Cinema with reviews of 'Side Effects', 'Identity Thief', and a surprising medical announcement about Tim's brain.

videos.title: 'A Good Day to Die Hard' and 'Escape from Planet Earth'
videos.overview: The popcorn -- and the fists -- come out as Tim and Gregg attempt to review 'A Good Day to Die Hard' and 'Escape from Planet Earth'.

videos.title: 'Snitch' and 'Dark Skies'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg explore the drug underworld in 'Snitch', discuss 'Dark Skies', and unveil a new segment featuring a special interview with actor Joe Estevez.

videos.title: '21 and Over' and 'Jack the Giant Slayer'
videos.overview: Laughter -- or maybe surgery -- is the best medicine on this week's On Cinema. Tim and Gregg discuss '21 and Over' and 'Jack the Giant Slayer', plus another Billy Crystal-themed popcorn classic.

videos.title: 'Oz the Great and Powerful' and 'Dead Man Down'
videos.overview: Despite the lack of Munchkins, Tim and Gregg feel pretty good about 'Oz the Great and Powerful', and 'Dead Man Down' includes an actor who never makes bad movies. This episode also introduces a provocative new political segment by Tim.

videos.title: 'Carrie' and 'The Incredible Burt Wonderstone'
videos.overview: No spoilers on this week's episode, but you will not believe the ending of the remake of 'Carrie'. And Popcorn Classics returns with not one but two classic video recommendations, because Tim and Gregg can't quite agree.

videos.title: 'The Croods'
videos.overview: Tim is excited to see how cavemen lived, and film expert Gregg Turkington answers questions for charity in a brand new segment.

videos.title: 'G.I. Joe: Retaliation' & 'Temptation: Confessions of a Marriage Counselor'
videos.overview: Again with Bruce Willis! Again with The Rock! Again with Channing Tatum! Throw in the real Tyler Perry and Jimmy McNichol and you've got a star-studded episode of On Cinema At The Cinema.

videos.title: 'The Company You Keep' and 'Jurassic Park 3D'
videos.overview: This week On Cinema reviews the latest releases by Soderbergh and Spielberg, including  'Jurassic Park 3D', where Tim shows his staunch devotion to the third dimension.

videos.title: 'Oblivion' and 'Scary Movie 5'
videos.overview: Explore new worlds this weekend in Tom Cruise's new film 'Oblivion' or snack on some eye candy in 'Scary Movie 5' -- or just reflect on life with Tim, because time is so valuable.

videos.title: 'The Lone Ranger' and 'Despicable Me 2'
videos.overview: Johnny Depp uses classic movie misdirection in 'The Lone Ranger' and Al Pacino puts in the finest performance of his career in 'Despicable Me 2' as Tim acclimates to his painful post-surgery life.

videos.title: 'Grown Ups 2' and 'Pacific Rim'
videos.overview: The gang is back together with big gross-out laughs in 'Grown Ups 2', and 'Pacific Rim' is one Tom Cruise short of a perfect rating.

videos.title: 'Turbo' and 'Red 2'
videos.overview: The childlike wonder of 'Turbo' is as entertaining as it is confusing, and 'Red 2' lives up to the high mark set by its predecessor.

videos.title: 'The Wolverine' and 'Blue Jasmine'
videos.overview: An incredibly long runtime doesn't hurt the brilliant "The Wolverine" and actor Joe Estevez comes by to discuss "Blue Jasmine" and the legacy of Woody Allen.

videos.title: 'The Smurfs 2' and '300: Rise of an Empire'
videos.overview: The Oscars may have to make a new category for 'The Smurfs 2' while '300: Rise of an Empire' sparks a debate over the importance of having characters who died in the first movie return for the sequel.

videos.title: 'Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters' and 'Elysium'
videos.overview: Tim doesn't need to see "Percy Jackson: Sea Of Monsters" and "Elysium" to know they are five baggers.

videos.title: 'Kick-Ass 2'
videos.overview: An argument over the setting of a Star Trek film means Tim and Gregg may have to cancel their 4:45 PM reservations at Carrabba's.

videos.title: 'The World's End' and 'The Colony'
videos.overview: The first episode since Gregg Turkington's dismissal marks a real turning point in Tim's life -- for the better!

videos.title: 'One Direction: This Is Us' and 'The Getaway'
videos.overview: Gregg throws a VHS-shaped wrench into Tim and Ayaka's relationship after he wonders who took his VHS copy of 'Airheads'.

videos.title: 'Riddick'
videos.overview: A simple deportation and a new Vin Diesel movie: all's right with the world!

videos.title: 'Lone Survivor' and 'Her'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg review the unofficial sequel to 'Zero Dark Thirty' and the unofficial remake of Al Pacino's 'S1m0ne.'

videos.title: 'The Nut Job' and 'Ride Along'
videos.overview: Tim's latest medical ailment can't stop him from discussing this week's hottest flicks and which two Hollywood stars he thinks should get together.

videos.title: 'I, Frankenstein' and 'Gimme Shelter'
videos.overview: Tim invites his acupuncturist on the show to tackle an updated monster classic and the problems with Western medicine.

videos.title: On Alternative Medicine On Cinema
videos.overview: This week, Tim discusses alternative blood clot treatments, 'That Awkward Moment', and 'Labor Day'.

videos.title: 'The Lego Movie' and 'Robocop'
videos.overview: A little medical fraud and seriously infected face sores can't stop Tim from doing what he loves best: reviewing the hottest movies.

videos.title: 'The Girl On a Bicycle' and 'Endless Love'
videos.overview: Gregg keeps the host seat warm with Tim away, and wastes no time delving into refined foreign film criticism with a very esteemed guest.

videos.title: 'Pompeii'
videos.overview: Tim is back in the hosting seat with a bag full of flax seeds to manage his new medical diagnosis.

videos.title: 'Welcome to Yesterday' (aka 'Almanac') and 'Non-Stop'
videos.overview: A new film enters the time travel movie pantheon, plus an exclusive sneak peek at Tim's forthcoming movie.

videos.title: 'Need for Speed' and 'Walk of Shame'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg put an end to the TV vs. film debate and play a high-stakes game of "Stump the Buff."

videos.title: 'Muppets Most Wanted'
videos.overview: In the season four finale, Tim and Gregg review the new Muppet film, talk about Joe Estevez's book, and debut a brand-new segment called "Tim's Mailbag."

videos.title: 'Deliver Us From Evil' and 'Tammy'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg give a five-bag summer blockbuster recap and discuss whether or not John Goodman is a true "man of the blues."

videos.title: 'Dawn of the Planet of the Apes' and 'And So It Goes'
videos.overview: This week, Tim discusses the home-brew coffee scene, and introduces a new "On Guests" segment so the audience can get to know some of their favorite On Cinema buffs.

videos.title: 'Jupiter Ascending' and 'Planes: Fire and Rescue'
videos.overview: Tim goes "hog" wild about a new business venture and Gregg shows off another famous location in cinema history.

videos.title: 'Wish I Was Here,' 'Hercules' and 'Magic in the Moonlight'
videos.overview: The buffs take a look at Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson's incredible transition into the world of acting, and Gregg gets a candid opinion on Woody Allen's new film from the resident On Cinema Woody Expert.

videos.title: 'Guardians of the Galaxy' and 'Get On Up'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg butt heads on whether sound effects in 'Guardians of the Galaxy' are more impressive than the Hollywood visuals, and Gregg delivers more expertise into cinema history in another On Location segment.

videos.title: 'Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles' and 'Into the Storm'
videos.overview: The buffs give us an in-depth look into the highly anticipated 'Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles,' and then grab their umbrellas to dive 'Into the Storm.'

videos.title: 'Let's Be Cops' and 'The Expendables 3'
videos.overview: This week our host rates two unmissable summer hits and discusses his action-espionage heroes, while guest Gregg Turkington premieres another exciting On Location segment.

videos.title: 'Sin City: A Dame to Kill For'
videos.overview: Tim discusses the future of Decker and the state of Hollywood sequels while guest Gregg Turkington gives us a cool "behind-the-scenes" look at a classic cinema location.

videos.title: 'The November Man' and 'Jessabelle'
videos.overview: Tim finds notes of Decker in The November Man while Gregg reveals his favorite Bond actor.

videos.title: 'Dark Places' and 'The Green Inferno'
videos.overview: Host Tim Heidecker and guest Gregg Turkington discuss this week's upcoming movies and Tom Hanks in the season five finale.

videos.title: 'Jupiter Ascending' and 'The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out Of Water'
videos.overview: Host Gregg Turkington introduces a new guest and reflects on a classic comedy of yesteryear.

videos.title: 'Fifty Shades of Grey' and 'Kingsman: The Secret Service'
videos.overview: Find out which movie is worth your money this Valentine's Day weekend.

videos.title: 'Hot Tub Time Machine 2' and 'McFarland USA'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg review two hotly awaited movies while also laying the groundwork for a much-anticipated sequel.

videos.title: 'Focus' and 'Lazarus'
videos.overview: It's a busy week with two fresh reviews, an update on Decker, another Popcorn Classic, and an urgent message from Tim.

videos.title: 'Chappie' and 'The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel'
videos.overview: The buffs critique two new flicks and dish on the hotly-awaited Decker sequel, Decker: Port of Call: Hawaii, with guest star Joe Estevez.

videos.title: 'In the Heart of the Sea' and 'Cinderella'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg squeeze in time between filming Decker: Port of Call: Hawaii to review a classic tale and the latest Ron Howard film.

videos.title: 'The Divergent Series: Insurgent' and 'The Gunman'
videos.overview: The duo sound off on a pair of new movies that bear a striking resemblance to Decker: Port of Call: Hawaii.

videos.title: 'Get Hard' and 'Home'
videos.overview: Tim and Gregg take another break from their busy shooting schedules to discuss the new Will Ferrell/Kevin Hart comedy and an animated treat.

videos.title: 'Furious 7' and 'Woman in Gold'
videos.overview: Rested and ready, Tim and Gregg delve into two new films and pay tribute to the late Paul Walker.

videos.title: 'Ex Machina' and 'The Moon and the Sun'
videos.overview: Get your tissues ready for an emotional episode as Tim reconciles with his guest host.

videos.title: 'Ant Man' and 'Fantastic Four'
videos.overview: On Cinema returns as Tim talks Ant-Man, Fantastic Four, and the future of Decker with guest Gregg Turkington.
